in_marathi.name: Balkrishan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balkrishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who carries the god Vishnu. This name is derived from the words 'Bala' meaning strength and 'Krishna' meaning God, or the dark one. It is a popular name in Hindu communities and is believed to bring blessings and prosperity.
